title: DBX-ASD: five questions to ask of every code snippet

steps.title: Does anything actually run?
steps.note: Transformations only add to the plan; each action starts a job; cache() is lazy

steps.title: Where does it run?
steps.note: Driver plans and schedules; executors run tasks; collect() pulls all to the driver

steps.title: How many pieces, does data move?
steps.note: One task per partition; wide operations shuffle; repartition vs coalesce; AQE

steps.title: What exactly comes back?
steps.note: Save modes, views, ANSI mode and try_* functions, join types

steps.title: In a stream, when is it final?
steps.note: Output modes; a watermark on the event-time column, before the aggregation

caption: Ask the five questions in this order before reading the options: it catches the most traps first.
alt: Five questions in order: does anything run, where does it run, how many pieces, what comes back, when is a streaming result final.
